blurb: This check verifies the AIX DHCP client (dhcpcd) is disabled: no dhcpcd process runs and /etc/rc.tcpip has no uncommented "start /usr/sbin/dhcpcd" line; a commented-out "#start /usr/sbin/dhcpcd" line is the normal "chrctcp -d dhcpcd" disabled state, not documentation of a needed client. A running DHCP client can silently obtain network configuration from an untrusted DHCP server. DISA STIG V-215355 requires the client disabled, Not Applicable unless needed by the system and documented; recognized only via an operator-written "# PTXRAY-EXEMPT: V-215355 <justification>" marker in /etc/rc.tcpip.
